questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the shared center lane is only for left turns from both directions. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: Which of these substances can impair your driving and lead to a DUII arrest?

options.text: Controlled substances, such as illegal drugs or prescription medicines
Inhalants, such as glue or paint

questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving. These include alcohol, illegal drugs, prescription medicines, over-the-counter medicines, and inhalants.

questions.question: You have a green light at an intersection, but pedestrians are crossing against the red light. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrians.
Stop to let the pedestrians cross safely.
Drive close to the pedestrians to scare them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to let the pedestrians cross safely.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians and other vehicles that may be in the intersection. Protect pedestrians in all situations.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: Why should you not follow other cars too closely?

options.text: You may not see the road between the cars.
You may not have time to stop if the car in front stops suddenly.
You may not see the car's turn signals.
You may not see the car's brake lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not have time to stop if the car in front stops suddenly.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely and the car ahead stops suddenly, you won't have enough time to avoid a crash.

questions.question: When are seat belts most effective?

options.text: When passengers wear them on long trips.
When all occupants wear them on expressways.
When all occupants wear them every time the car is driven.

questions.correctAnswerText: When all occupants wear them every time the car is driven.
questions.explanation: Everyone in the car should wear a seat belt every time you drive. In a crash, a person without a seat belt becomes a dangerous object inside the car.

questions.question: What color are signs that show the distance to the next exit on a highway?
questions.explanation: Signs that give information about destinations are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is nearby, what should you do?

options.text: Stop your vehicle immediately and block its path.
Do everything you can to clear a path for it.
Signal the emergency vehicle when it is safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do everything you can to clear a path for it.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is nearby, clear a path for it. If safe, pull to the side of the road to let it pass.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: Large vehicles have larger blind spots. Trucks and large SUVs have areas near the rear that cannot be seen in the side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: What does a red and white triangular sign mean at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular yield sign means you must slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Be prepared to stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely before you go.

questions.question: Drivers may not pass from either side of a ____ centerline.
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no one can cross it to pass. This rule applies to traffic going in both directions.

questions.question: When changing lanes on a highway, you should:

options.text: Check your rearview and side mirrors.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, signal in advance, check your mirrors, and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What is the best way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a traffic crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on multilane highways.
Limit your driving to 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.

questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the single best way to protect yourself from death or injury while driving.

questions.question: Activate your turn signal at least ____ before turning.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 200 feet before changing lanes or turning. If you are driving faster than 50 mph, signal at least 300 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roadways with a median between them. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: If you are involved in a serious traffic crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle and move it off the road if possible. Check if anyone is hurt. Call 911 if needed. Call police if there is an injury, a death, or more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: Checking your blind spot before changing lanes, driving away from a curb, or merging into traffic is:

options.text: Not necessary if you use the rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: Always check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: If you are involved in an accident, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop immediately and move your vehicle out of traffic if you can. Call the police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Help stop severe bleeding with pressure. Wait for emergency vehicles to arrive.

questions.question: Drinking alcohol and driving is:

options.text: Safe if you have only had a few drinks.
Only dangerous to the driver who drinks.

questions.explanation: Driving while impaired is a serious safety problem. You cannot drive safely after drinking alcohol or using drugs. It puts you and everyone on the road at risk.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when turning. Go at a speed that lets you stay in control, keep your car in your lane, and handle surprises.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: On long trips, you can prevent drowsiness by:

options.text: Stopping at regular intervals for a rest.
Moving your eyes from side to side as you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stopping at regular intervals for a rest.
questions.explanation: Stop regularly during long trips to rest and stretch. Take breaks even if you don't feel tired yet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means you cannot park here at any time of day or night.

questions.question: What is the only way to reduce your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Allow your body time to get rid of the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow your body time to get rid of the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only waiting can lower your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot reduce alcohol in your system or make you sober. They may keep you awake, but they don't change your BAC.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to your driving skills and judgement?

options.text: It helps driving skills but harms your judgement.
It harms both driving skills and judgement.
It has no effect on either driving skills or judgement.
It has no effect on judgement but it harms driving skills.

questions.correctAnswerText: It harms both driving skills and judgement.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes it harder to see clearly. It also affects your judgment of speed and distance, makes you take more risks, and lowers your inhibitions.

questions.question: When approaching a flashing red traffic light, drivers should:

options.text: Drive through the intersection if there is no crossing traffic.
Continue driving, as they have the right-of-way.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat the light like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the light like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is used at dangerous intersections. Treat it the same as a stop sign and come to a complete stop.

questions.question: You must stop at a railroad crossing when:

options.text: Directed to do so by a flagger.
It is controlled by a stop sign.
Flashing red signals and gates are present and operating.

questions.explanation: Stop at railroad crossings when a flagger directs you to, when there is a stop sign, or when flashing red signals and gates are working.
